goal.text: The shelving assistants get a sorted list at noon and at closing time, so reserved books stop getting shelved by mistake.
cites: [A:A01 "so reserved books stop getting shelved by mistake"]

agent_checkable.metric: Rows for books with a reservation flag that say shelve
agent_checkable.check: A script compares each row's decision with the reservation flag in the export (Q01).
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a book with a reservation flag never goes to shelve (blocker)."]

agent_checkable.check: Compare the time each list takes with how long sorting takes today.

outcome.metric: Reserved books found on the open shelves
cites: [A:A01 "No reserved book on the open shelves in a month."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Clear the crates from the list.
cites: [A:A01 "Shelving assistants (users: clear the crates from the list)."]

steps: An assistant empties the chute crates.
The assistant reads the screen for reservations.
The assistant puts it on a trolley.
problems: About one reserved book in twenty ends up on the open shelves.
Torn books go out again to the next reader.
cites: [A:A01 "about one reserved book in twenty ends up on the open shelves"]

in: The chute returns since the last list in.
A sorted list (shelve, reservations shelf, mending crate) out.
cites: [A:A01 "Out: overdue charges, donations, the local history room."]

inputs.description: The returns export, about 80 a day.
inputs.format: plain text, one book per line

glossary.meaning: The shelf by the desk for books waiting for the reader who reserved them.
The crate for books that need mending before they go out again.
The export's yes or no for an open reservation.
cites: [A:A01 "Reservation flag: the export's yes or no for an open reservation."]

glossary.meaning: Someone looks at the book before it is sorted.
cites: [A:A01 "Check by hand: someone looks at the book before it is sorted."]

acceptance_tests.words: I run two days of made-up chute returns through it, and every reserved book is on the reservations shelf part of the list.
cites: [A:A01 "I run two days of made-up chute returns through it, and every reserved book is on the reservations shelf part of the list."]

ranks.use_for: Rules, scope, what counts as damage

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the barcode and the export line that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a row goes to 'check by hand' and is raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: One row per returned book, with a decision: shelve, reservations shelf, mending crate or check by hand. A line with no title is listed as 'check by hand'. It refuses to sort donations.

fields.name: barcode
fields.description: The barcode, quoted from the export.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: shelve, reservations shelf, mending crate or check by hand.

cites: [A:A01 "A line with no title is listed as 'check by hand'."]

rules.statement: A book with a reservation flag never goes to shelve.
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 a book with a reservation flag never goes to shelve (blocker)."]

rules.statement: A damage note that is not blank sends the book to the mending crate.
cites: [A:A01 "sends the book to the mending crate (major)."]

rules.statement: Every row quotes the barcode from the export.
cites: [A:A01 "Q03 every row quotes the barcode from the export (major)."]

good.text: Harbour Lights | no reservation, no damage | shelve
The Glass Orchard | reserved | reservations shelf

bad.text: Ten Small Hills | torn page | shelve

risk.notes: A book on the wrong shelf can be moved back, but a reader who was told it is ready leaves without it. Readers are affected.
cites: [A:A02 "Readers who reserve books, about two hundred a month."]

systems.description: The day's returns export, as text.

gates.decision: Approve or reject the sorted list before anyone acts on it.
cites: [A:A01 "I sign off each list before the crates are cleared."]

open_questions.question: Do inter-library loans get their own decision?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every reserved book right on two weeks of made-up chute returns.
cites: [A:A02 "It must get every reserved book right on two weeks of made-up chute returns."]
